info resource-folded: Storage (AWS::CloudFormation::Stack) of main.yaml is read as the resources of its template storage.yaml, which join the draft as StorageQueue, StorageQueuePolicy; nothing is drafted for it
warn reference-not-wired: Reader sets the variable QUEUE_URL at Properties.Environment.Variables.QUEUE_URL from the identifier of StorageQueue, and the drafted Aggregate does not wire it: StorageQueue publishes no provides key for it; the instance reader is connected to storage-queue for the dependency alone, a comment above the connection saying why; write the value where the instance is configured
warn resource-not-carried: StorageQueuePolicy (AWS::SQS::QueuePolicy) is not carried: the Recipe of core/messaging/sqs the instance of StorageQueue takes carries none of it, since the Recipe writes no queue policy, so grant access to the queue outside the draft; nothing is drafted for it, so where it is wanted, set it on the deployed resource outside the draft
